caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden bucket with a rounded base and vertical sides. The bucket is light brown in color with visible wood grain and texture. It is reinforced by two horizontal bands around the top and bottom, which appear to be made of the same wood material. There is a single handle attached on either side with round wooden fasteners, and the handle arches above the opening of the bucket. The bucket is placed centrally on a plain, off-white background, and there are no additional objects or elements in the composition. The shading and lines give a three-dimensional appearance to the bucket.
title: Sugar Bucket
